name: Frog
desc: Glass-frog rendered as a glowing X-ray of spine, ribs and a pulsing heart, croak-sac inflating on the beat and leaping across the stage, switchable to iridescent poison-dart stipple, linocut, wireframe or murky swamp chiaroscuro.

pose.doc: idle=breathe, ribbit=throat-pump, swim=leg-kick glide, hop=crouch-leap arc

style.doc: aesthetic: bioluminescent X-ray of bones+organs (abstract) / iridescent poison-dart stipple / high-contrast linocut / luminous wireframe / murky swamp chiaroscuro

act.doc: multi-minute dramaturgy: pond calm, rain frantic croaking, dusk slow
